title: Jeff's Farm — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Spanish Italian language learning warm baritone 100bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe farm portrait character
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Jeff was up before the light came over.
He walked the rows before the workers arrived.
Not distrust — just what a farming man does.
When he spoke, they listened. Respect earned slow.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Jeff se levantaba antes de que llegara la luz. (Jeff was up before the light came over.)
Caminaba por las filas antes de que llegaran los trabajadores. (He walked the rows before the workers arrived.)
No era desconfianza — solo lo que hace un hombre de granja. (Not distrust — just what a farming man does.)
Cuando hablaba, todos escuchaban. Respeto ganado lentamente. (When he spoke, they listened. Respect earned slow.)
El tipo de hombre por quien trabajas duro (The kind of man you work hard for)
Porque sabes que él sabe lo que tú sabes. (Because you know he knows what you know.)

[Chorus - Italian, with English translations]
La fattoria di Jeff (Jeff's farm)
Dove i lavoratori tornavano ogni mattina (Where the workers came back every morning)
La fattoria di Jeff (Jeff's farm)
Dove il rispetto si guadagnava e si manteneva (Where respect was earned and kept)
La fattoria di Jeff (Jeff's farm)
Dove la polvere rossa racconta storie (Where red dust tells the stories)
Che le persone lì già conoscono (That the people there already know)

[Bridge - all three]
English: They left the farm. But they brought it with them. You always do.
Spanish: Dejaron la granja. Pero la llevaron consigo. Siempre lo haces. (They left the farm. But brought it. You always do.)
Italian: Hanno lasciato la fattoria. Ma l'hanno portata con loro. Lo fai sempre. (They left the farm. But brought it. You always do.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Jeff's farm — still in how they carry themselves
Spanish: La granja de Jeff — todavía en cómo se llevan a sí mismos (Jeff's farm — still in how they carry themselves)
Italian: La fattoria di Jeff — ancora in come si portano (Jeff's farm — still in how they carry themselves)
